## Terminal

About package and environments management: [Introduction to GIS Programming - Miniconda](https://geog-312.gishub.org/book/software/miniconda.html)

```{bash}
conda create -n pythonenv python=3.12
conda activate pythonenv
conda install -n base mamba -c conda-forge
mamba install -c conda-forge geemap leafmap
conda env list
conda env export --from-history > environment.yml
conda env create -f environment.yml
conda remove -n myenv --all
conda install -n base mamba -c conda-forge
mamba install -c conda-forge geemap leafmap
```

To set the [Github project](https://github.com/antunesbernardo/Invasive_Newts_Landscape_Genetics).

```{bash}
git --version
git init
git status
git add
git commit -m "Initial commit"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/antunesbernardo/Invasive_Newts_Landscape_Genetics.git
git remote -v
git push -u origin main

git add .
git commit -m "Describe what you changed"
git push
```
